paper.title_en: EAQECCs from constacyclic codes over the finite non-chain ring $\mathbb {F}_{q}[v]/\langle v^3-v\rangle $
paper.abstract_en: Let $ R=\mathbb {F}_q[v]/\langle v^3-v\rangle $ be a finite non-chain ring, where $q$ is an odd prime power. In this paper, we construct a class of entanglement-assisted quantum error-correcting codes (EAQECCs), including some maximal entanglement entanglement-assisted quantum error-correcting codes (ME-EAQECCs) via the Gray images of constacyclic codes over $R$. Several such codes are presented to demonstrate the effectiveness of our construction. Moreover, the codes constructed in this work are new, and their parameters are superior to those of the known EAQECCs provided in [1 ].
